text:
Maria G.: Quick sync: PR #27831 (cache-eviction) is ready but CI started failing intermittent GPU tests. Holding merge until we confirm canary + rebase window. Who can give final approval? :eyes:

Ashwin R.: I can look — what's failing in CI? can you paste the failing job link?

Maria G.: Fails are flaky: gpu-e2e-64 timeout on test_batching; logs show OOM > not deterministic. CI link: https://ci.redwood/27831/jobs/3421

ci-bot: Job gpu-e2e-64 — timed out (10m) — rerun queued by @maria

Jordan L.: Recommend we hold until after nightly deploy freeze at 02:00 UTC. If canary passes we can land during rebase window at 06:00 UTC. Otherwise defer to next slot. :calendar:

Ashwin R.: I can approve after I run a quick local reproduce. If you can rebase onto main and kick the canary, tag me.

Maria G.: On it — rebasing now. Quick commands:
```
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
git push --force-with-lease
```

ci-bot: Rebase detected; starting canary pipeline (canary-asia-1).

Maria G.: Canary started. @release-eng — FYI this PR touches batching kernels; want to avoid landing during the frozen window.

release-eng: Thanks — noted. If canary is green by 01:30 UTC we can try a manual land with rollback plan. If it fails keep it queued. Also make sure to update the rollout notes with the revert flag.

Jordan L.: If canary is flaky we should consider a small revertable commit to reduce exposure (feature flag). Also ping infra for extra GPU headroom if the canary hit OOMs.

Ashwin R.: Local run reproduced the timeout once, otherwise green. LGTM pending canary. I'll leave an approval on GitHub after canary passes.

Maria G.: :thumbsup: Thanks. Will update thread with canary result. If canary fails, I'll open a follow-up PR with smaller kernel change.

ci-bot: Canary pipeline complete: canary-asia-1 = success, canary-eu-2 = intermittent timeout (rerun recommended). Rerun queued.

Maria G.: Rerun in progress. If both green by 01:25 UTC we'll land in the rebase window; otherwise postponing to next morning. Appreciate the quick eyes.
